dedupe_keys.name: west african power pool wapp pipes project database icc operational indicators and regional market documents

description: The West African Power Pool, the ECOWAS agency that brings together the region's national electricity companies, publishes information on regional generation and transmission projects, system operation and the regional electricity market across three sites. Coverage: ECOWAS member states; the PIPES site (Planning, Investment Programming and Environmental Safeguards) lists generation, transmission and other projects by status (under preparation, under implementation, finalised, and pending funding for studies or implementation) and by country or interconnection, with project pages such as the 240 MW Kaleta and 450 MW Souapiti hydropower plants in Guinea; the Information and Coordination Centre (ICC) in Cotonou shows key indicators such as available capacity, imported and exported energy and available capacity against peak load for 2022, and holds reports on reliability, synchronisation and market development, a GIS and a dashboard; the main site's documentation library holds General Assembly decisions, the master plan, the ECOWAS Energy Protocol, business plans and ERERA regulatory decisions, for example the 2026 regional transmission tariff methodology and market fee procedure. Format and access: HTML pages, chart images and PDF documents, free; some sections need a login. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the ICC indicators shown were for 2022 only, the PIPES project pages were not opened one by one, and the GIS and dashboard were not read. Simulation uses: planned interconnections and plants and regional capacity balances for West African power expansion, cross-border trade and adequacy models. Related records: the Southern African Power Pool (data-sapp-southern-african-power-pool-technical-and-market-data) publishes similar data for its region.
